title: Admin email send-test and safe verification resend
summary: Super Admins can send themselves a test of any email, and Admins can safely resend a verification email to a Public Login account.
changes: Send a test of any email with sample data to your own address only, up to 5 times every 10 minutes.
Resend the verification email from an unverified Public Login account's Admin page, up to 3 times an hour per account.
Build a brand-new verification link for every resend and record each test and resend in the audit log.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: two guarded Admin actions on top of Admin Emails.
validation: Admin Emails and Staff Login reminder tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Send test is for Super Admins only; Administrators can preview but not send.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
